description: Split from candidate 5 in the review. safepoint_saves (compiler.ex L6090-6125) parses /* defk:in N */ markers out of the emitted C, and Defk.Report.full parses /* defk:loop */ (report.ex L337-360). Deepen the same way as the strip record (defk-ch4): the lowering declares a row when it emits the marker, the emitter and the report read rows. Crosses emitting and resume logic, so it is its own ticket after the guard-flags ticket. Gate: mix dump_c byte-identical; resume_test (4 C greps may move to rows), report_test.
title: Safepoint markers: rows instead of /* defk:in N */ comments parsed back from the C
